meta.name: permission-tuner
meta.description: Analyze permission denial patterns and generate optimized alwaysAllow and alwaysDeny rules. Use when permission prompts are slowing you down or after sessions with many denials.

copy.tagline: 分析权限拒绝模式并自动生成优化规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常被权限弹窗打断工作，想自动优化权限规则。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze permission denial patterns and auto-generate optimized rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're frequently interrupted by permission prompts and want to auto-optimize rules.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 分析权限拒绝模式，生成自动允许和自动拒绝规则，减少权限提示干扰。
howto.when: 当权限提示频繁打断工作流，或开始新项目需要配置权限时触发。

say.text: 分析我最近的权限拒绝模式，生成自动允许规则。
say.note: Claude 会扫描会话数据并给出规则建议。

say.text: 为我的新项目配置权限，自动允许只读操作。
say.note: Claude 会生成针对新项目的权限规则。

say.text: 把 git push 加入自动拒绝列表。
say.note: Claude 会更新 deny 规则。

howto.what_en: Analyze permission denial patterns and generate optimized alwaysAllow and alwaysDeny rules to reduce prompt fatigue.
howto.when_en: Triggered when permission prompts interrupt flow repeatedly, or when starting a new project and wanting to configure permissions.

say_en.text: Analyze my recent permission denial patterns and generate alwaysAllow rules.
say_en.note: Claude will scan session data and suggest rules.

say_en.text: Configure permissions for my new project, auto-approve read-only operations.
say_en.note: Claude will generate rules for the new project.

say_en.text: Add git push to the auto-deny list.
say_en.note: Claude will update the deny rules.
